claims.statement: There exists a quadratic three-species five-reaction rank-three mass-action network with exactly four distinct positive nondegenerate equilibria at positive rational rate constants.
claims.mathematical_status: proved in candidate manuscript; internally checked

claims.statement: For every integer n>=2, an explicit quadratic (n,n+2,n) mass-action network has exactly n+1 positive equilibria, all nondegenerate.
claims.finite_checks: Supplementary only; dimensions and counts are recorded in executed receipts.

claims.statement: The all-dimensional construction realizes an existing Phillipson-Rojas polynomial chain as a mass-action network with integer products and positive rational rates. Invertible equation operations preserve equilibria and Jacobian nonsingularity, not dynamics or stability.
The inflow-free five-reaction example has maximum product molecularity ten and exactly four positive nondegenerate equilibria for fourth rate 1/K precisely when 1568<K<117649/75.
claims.mathematical_status: analytic proof in candidate manuscript and supplement

claims.statement: For the reciprocal example N=7, K=145, the four equilibria ordered by scalar parameter are a saddle, sink, saddle, sink; each saddle has exactly one unstable direction.
